meta.title: ADA Restroom Accessibility Inspection
meta.description: Answer all questions. If you select NO, review the suggested correction.

questions.title: Requirement 3.1
questions.question: If toilet rooms are available to the public, is at least one toilet room accessible? (Either one for each sex, or one unisex.)
questions.help: Note: If toilet rooms are chiefly for children, e.g., in elementary schools and day care centers, use the children’s specifications in Toilets - 604.1, 604.8, 604.9, 609.4 and Lavatories and Sinks – 606.2.
solutionsIfNo: Combine toilet rooms to create one unisex accessible toilet room

questions.title: Requirement 3.2
questions.question: Are there signs at inaccessible toilet rooms that give directions to accessible toilet rooms?

questions.title: Requirement 3.3
questions.question: If not all toilet rooms are accessible, is there a sign at the accessible toilet room with the International Symbol of Accessibility?

questions.title: Requirement 3.4
questions.question: Is there an accessible route to the toilet room?

questions.title: Requirement 3.5
questions.question: If toilet rooms are available to the public, is at least one toilet room accessible? (Either one for each sex, or one unisex.)

questions.title: Requirement 3.6
questions.question: Is the toilet room door opening at least 32 inches clear when open 90 degrees?

questions.title: Requirement 3.7
questions.question: Is door hardware operable without tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist?

questions.title: Requirement 3.8
questions.question: Does the door have a smooth surface on the push side within 10 inches of the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.9
questions.question: Is the door threshold no higher than 1/2 inch?

questions.title: Requirement 3.10
questions.question: Is there adequate maneuvering clearance at the toilet room door?
solutionsIfNo: Reconfigure space to provide required clearance

questions.title: Requirement 3.11
questions.question: Does the door open into the required clear floor space or clearance for any fixture?

questions.title: Requirement 3.12
questions.question: Is there a minimum 60-inch diameter turning space or a T-turn within the toilet room?
solutionsIfNo: Reconfigure fixtures/partitions to provide turning space

questions.title: Requirement 3.13
questions.question: If there is a vestibule, is there adequate maneuvering clearance at both doors?

questions.title: Requirement 3.14
questions.question: Is there an accessible route to all toilet compartments and fixtures?
solutionsIfNo: Reconfigure layout to provide accessible route

questions.title: Requirement 3.15
questions.question: Are protruding objects limited so they do not reduce circulation paths?

questions.title: Requirement 3.16
questions.question: Are controls and dispensers within accessible reach ranges?

questions.title: Requirement 3.17
questions.question: Is the accessible route at least 36 inches wide?

questions.title: Requirement 3.18
questions.question: Is the floor surface stable, firm, and slip-resistant?

questions.title: Requirement 3.19
questions.question: Is there at least one accessible toilet compartment?
solutionsIfNo: Reconfigure stalls to create an accessible compartment

questions.title: Requirement 3.20
questions.question: Is there at least one accessible ambulatory compartment where required?
solutionsIfNo: Reconfigure stalls to create an ambulatory compartment

questions.title: Requirement 3.21
questions.question: Is the top of the lavatory no higher than 34 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.22
questions.question: Is there adequate knee clearance under the lavatory?
solutionsIfNo: Remove/modify cabinetry to provide knee clearance

questions.title: Requirement 3.23
questions.question: Are pipes and surfaces under the lavatory insulated or otherwise protected?

questions.title: Requirement 3.24
questions.question: Are faucets operable with one hand and without tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist?

questions.title: Requirement 3.25
questions.question: Is there clear floor space positioned for a forward approach at the lavatory?
solutionsIfNo: Reconfigure lavatory area to provide clear floor space

questions.title: Requirement 3.26
questions.question: Is the mirror mounted with the bottom edge of the reflecting surface no higher than 40 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.27
questions.question: Are soap dispensers within accessible reach range?

questions.title: Requirement 3.28
questions.question: Are paper towel dispensers or hand dryers within accessible reach range?

questions.title: Requirement 3.29
questions.question: Is there a trash receptacle located so it does not obstruct required clear floor space?

questions.title: Requirement 3.30
questions.question: Is the centerline of the toilet 16 to 18 inches from the side wall or partition?

questions.title: Requirement 3.31
questions.question: Is the toilet seat height 17 to 19 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.32
questions.question: Is there adequate clearance around the toilet (60 inches minimum from side wall and 56 inches minimum from rear wall for wall-hung, 59 inches for floor-mounted)?
solutionsIfNo: Reconfigure toilet area to provide clearance

questions.title: Requirement 3.33
questions.question: Are grab bars provided at the toilet and installed correctly?

questions.title: Requirement 3.34
questions.question: Are grab bars mounted 33 to 36 inches above the floor to the top of the gripping surface?
solutionsIfNo: Reinstall grab bars at correct height

questions.title: Requirement 3.35
questions.question: Is the toilet paper dispenser located within reach and not behind the grab bars?

questions.title: Requirement 3.36
questions.question: Is the flush control located on the open side of the toilet and operable?

questions.title: Requirement 3.37
questions.question: Is there an accessible coat hook/shelf where provided?
solutionsIfNo: Install/relocate coat hook/shelf to compliant height

questions.title: Requirement 3.38
questions.question: Is the accessible toilet compartment door self-closing and does it not swing into required clearances?

questions.title: Requirement 3.39
questions.question: Does the accessible toilet compartment provide required door width and clearance?
solutionsIfNo: Reconfigure stall partitions/door to meet requirements

questions.title: Requirement 3.40
questions.question: If urinals are provided, is at least one urinal accessible?

questions.title: Requirement 3.41
questions.question: Is the urinal rim no higher than 17 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.42
questions.question: Is there clear floor space for the urinal?
solutionsIfNo: Reconfigure urinal area to provide clear floor space

questions.title: Requirement 3.43
questions.question: Are dispensers (soap, towels, etc.) mounted within accessible reach ranges?
solutionsIfNo: Relocate dispensers to compliant reach range

questions.title: Requirement 3.44
questions.question: Is the waste receptacle placed so it does not obstruct accessible clear floor space?

questions.title: Requirement 3.45
questions.question: Are sanitary napkin disposal units within reach and not blocking clear floor space?

questions.title: Requirement 3.46
questions.question: Are baby changing stations (if provided) within accessible reach and operable?

questions.title: Requirement 3.47
questions.question: Is the alarm/pull cord (if provided) reachable and operable?

questions.title: Requirement 3.48
questions.question: Are accessories and controls not requiring tight grasping, pinching, or twisting?

questions.title: Requirement 3.49
questions.question: Are all required elements maintained in operable working condition?

questions.title: Requirement 3.50
questions.question: Are there any other barriers that prevent access or use by people with disabilities?
